Order 
This miscellaneous appeal by appellant/claimant under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act.

1988 is arising out of the Award dated 13.02.2021 passed by 26th Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Indore (hereinafter it would be referred to as "the Claims Tribunal") in Claim Case No.1924/2018 seeking enhancement of compensation amount.
2.
The date of accident, negligence and issue of liability are not in dispute and the findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal in this regard are also not in question.

3. As per the findings of the Claims Tribunal, for the death of Kaluh (husband of appellant No.1- herein), the Claims Tribunal after assessing the income of deceased at Rs.7050/- per month,
applying 40% towards future prospects and applying multiplier of 18 including filial consortium,
funeral and NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:6098 2 MA-1184-2021 loss of estate, has awarded a total compensation of Rs.16,69,048/- along-with interest in favour of Claimants from the date of filing of claim petition till its realization.

4. Learned counsel for the appellant contends that Claims Tribunal has committed an error in not awarding just and proper amount of compensation in the case as the amount awarded by the Claims Tribunal is on the lower side.

The Claims Tribunal has committed an error in assessing the income Sunita vs National Insurance Company Ltd. on 7 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45016542/
1 of the deceased as Rs.7050/- per month.

sentences.text: As per the evidence came on record, he was a mason by profession.

However, accepting earning of deceased as Rs.7,500/- per month in view of the Minimum Wages Act and adding future prospects, applying adequate multiplier including compensation under other conventional heads, the reasonable amount of compensation may be awarded.

5. On the other hand, learned counsel for Insurance Company has argued in support of the impugned Award and contended that the Claims Tribunal has rightly awarded the compensation amount in the case, which does not call for any interference by this Court.

6. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
7.
After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record, I find substance in the arguments advanced by the counsel for the appellants.

So far as income of the deceased is concerned, as per the evidence that came on record, he was a mason, therefore, in view of Minimum Wages Act, his income should be assessed appropriately as Rs.7500/- per month.
Therefore, his income is fixed as Rs.7,500/- per month instead of Rs.7050/- per month as assessed by the Claims Tribunal.

8. It is needless to mention here that appellant No.1 is the wife, appellant No.2 is daughter of deceased and appellants No.3 and 4 are sons of deceased, NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:6098 3 MA-1184-2021 therefore, they are entitled to get towards loss of filial consortium @ Rs.40,000/- each.
9.
In view of above, the compensation awarded by the Claims Tribunal is modified as under:

Monthly income Rs.7500/-
 Future prospects 40 % =Rs.3000/-
 Yearly Income = 10500x12=1,26,000/-
 After deduction of Loss of dependency 1/4th  
 31500/=94,500/-
 Multiplier 18  Total amount towards dependency:

(Rs.94500x18=17,01,000/-
 Other Heads:-
Loss of filial Consortium-(Rs.40,000X 6) =Rs. 2,40,000/-

TOTAL =Rs.19,71,000/-

11. In the result, this miscellaneous appeal is partly allowed, by enhancing the compensation amount by a sum of Rs.3,01,000/-.

Hence, the claimants are entitled to get total Rs.19,71,000/-
(Rs.16,69,048/-+Rs.3,01,000/-) as compensation.
The enhanced amount shall carry interest as fixed by the learned NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:6098 4 MA-1184-2021 Claims Tribunal from the date of filing of claim petition till its realization.
The said amount be paid within a period of three month s from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
Rest of conditions as imposed by learned Claims Tribunal shall remain intact.

12. If the enhanced amount of compensation is in excess to the valuation of appeal, the difference of the Court fee (if not already paid) shall be deposited by the appellants- claimants within a period of one month and proof thereof, shall be submitted before the Registry.
Thereafter, the Registry shall issue the certified copy of the order passed today.
13. In view of above, miscellaneous appeal filed by the appellants- claimants stands disposed of.
